## Goal
Tighten share_candidate promotion so client-side nominations can safely feed shared-kb without leaking private lane data or losing provenance.

## Scope
- Preserve sync secret/private rejection behavior.
- Add or verify async worthiness, deduplication, target_namespace, and provenance links back to source lane/event.
- Ensure only server-approved events enter shared-kb.
- Add regression tests for private content rejection and provenance retention.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Promotion path records source lane/event provenance safely.
- Private/secret candidates are rejected before async promotion can see them.
- Tests cover target namespace and legacy collab/shared-kb behavior.

## Timeline
Target date: 2026-06-28.
